head_commit.message:
Preserve Windows fixture repair and expose exact copied-state failures

Reconcile all published 6287055 evidence and the exact constexpr-else fixture repair. Preserve original source pins through the independently reviewed helper-to-cast-to-baseline reversal; retain all prior admissions and add seven adversarial methods. Four affected checks pass with an identical Linux fixture binary.

Retain predecessor Windows 66/68 and its two unlocalized copied-state protocol failures. Add bounded failure-only leaf/type/value details to the existing title and header validators without changing acceptance predicates, expected values, numerical criteria or timeouts. Three affected local checks pass; no Windows repair or complete platform pass is claimed. Production application and gallery remain unchanged. Exact-source hosted qualification and the last worker closure follow publication.
